jobs.text: 형사님이 세아 오르골 사진 보여 주셨어요. 하루 씨가 감았을 때 한 마디만 나왔다면서요. 세아가 9월에 고친 건데…
jobs.instructions: A Korean woman in her mid-twenties leaving a voice message on her phone, holding it close to her mouth (about 20 cm) in a small studio flat, speaking almost to herself, unhurried. Warm, a little bright at the start. Pace it like this: the first sentence takes about 3.5 seconds; after a short breath, the second sentence takes about 5 seconds; after another breath, the last sentence is slow, about 4 seconds, her throat tightening slightly, close to tears, trailing off at the very end. Natural and intimate, not theatrical. Whole message about 14 seconds. Say the name 세아 as two clean syllables 'se-a' with no breath or h between them; pronounce 고친 clearly as 'go-chin'.
